# `execution/git-provider.ts`

This module provides a unified abstraction for interacting with Git hosting providers (GitHub and Azure DevOps). It includes utilities for executing Git commands, extracting PR numbers from URLs, and provider implementations that support cloning, branching, committing, pushing, and pull request management.

## Types & Interfaces

### `PRComment`

Represents a single comment on a pull request.

```ts
interface PRComment {
  id: number;
  body: string;
  author: string;
  createdAt: string;
}
```

| Member      | Type     | Description                        |
|-------------|----------|------------------------------------|
| `id`        | `number` | Unique identifier for the comment. |
| `body`      | `string` | Text content of the comment.       |
| `author`    | `string` | Username or display name of the comment author. |
| `createdAt` | `string` | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was created. |

---

### `CloneOptions`

Optional configuration passed to clone operations.

```ts
interface CloneOptions {
  depth?: number;
}
```

| Member  | Type     | Required | Description                                         |
|---------|----------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| `depth` | `number` | No       | Shallow clone depth. Omit for a full clone.         |

### `GitProvider`

Interface defining the contract for Git provider implementations. Both [`GitHubProvider`](#githubprovider) and [`AzureDevOpsProvider`](#azuredevopsprovider) implement this interface.

```ts
interface GitProvider {}
```

> **Note:** The interface currently declares no members directly. See the concrete provider classes for the full set of methods.

## Functions

### `redactArgs`

> ⚠️ **Not a named export.** This function is internal to the module.

Redacts sensitive values from a Git argument array, preventing credentials from appearing in logs or error output.

**Signature:**

```ts
function redactArgs(args: string[]): string[]
```

**Parameters:**

| Name   | Type       | Description                            |
|--------|------------|----------------------------------------|
| `args` | `string[]` | Array of Git command arguments to redact. |

**Returns:** `string[]` — A new array with sensitive values replaced.

---

### `execGit`

> ⚠️ **Not a named export.** This function is internal to the module.

Runs a Git command via `execFile` and returns its `stdout`. Prevents credential prompts by setting `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` in the child process environment.

**Signature:**

```ts
async function execGit(args: string[], cwd: string): Promise<string>
```

**Parameters:**

| Name   | Type       | Description                                      |
|--------|------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `args` | `string[]` | Arguments to pass to the `git` executable.       |
| `cwd`  | `string`   | Working directory in which to run the command.   |

**Returns:** `Promise<string>` — Resolves with the trimmed `stdout` of the Git command.

**Example:**

```ts
const log = await execGit(['log', '--oneline', '-5'], '/path/to/repo');
console.log(log);
```

### `extractGitHubPRNumber`

Extracts the pull request number from a GitHub pull request URL.

```ts
import { extractGitHubPRNumber } from '...'
```

**Signature:**

```ts
function extractGitHubPRNumber(prUrl: string): number
```

**Parameters:**

| Name    | Type     | Description                    |
|---------|----------|--------------------------------|
| `prUrl` | `string` | A GitHub pull request URL.     |

**Returns:** `number` — The numeric pull request identifier.

**Example:**

```ts
const prNumber = extractGitHubPRNumber(
  'https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42'
);
// → 42
```

---

### `extractAdoPRNumber`

Extracts the pull request number from an Azure DevOps pull request URL.

```ts
import { extractAdoPRNumber } from '...'
```

**Signature:**

```ts
function extractAdoPRNumber(prUrl: string): number
```

**Parameters:**

| Name    | Type     | Description                          |
|---------|----------|--------------------------------------|
| `prUrl` | `string` | An Azure DevOps pull request URL.    |

**Returns:** `number` — The numeric pull request identifier.

**Example:**

```ts
const prNumber = extractAdoPRNumber(
  'https://dev.azure.com/org/project/_git/repo/pullrequest/77'
);
// → 77
```

### `getGitProvider`

Returns the appropriate `GitProvider` implementation for the given provider string.

```ts
import { getGitProvider } from '...'
```

**Signature:**

```ts
function getGitProvider(provider: string): GitProvider
```

**Parameters:**

| Name       | Type     | Description                                                    |
|------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| `provider` | `string` | Identifier for the desired Git provider (e.g. `"github"`, `"azuredevops"`). |

**Returns:** `GitProvider` — An instance of the matching provider class.

**Example:**

```ts
const provider = getGitProvider('github');
```

## Classes

### `GitHubProvider`

```ts
import { GitHubProvider } from '...'
```

Implements `GitProvider` for GitHub. Provides methods to clone repositories, manage branches, commit and push changes, and interact with GitHub pull requests via the GitHub API.

---

#### `GitHubProvider.clone`

Clones a GitHub repository to a local directory.

```ts
async clone(
  repoFullName: string,
  targetDir: string,
  branch: string,
  creds: GitCredentials,
  opts?: CloneOptions
): Promise<void>
```

| Parameter      | Type             | Required | Description                                          |
|----------------|------------------|----------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `repoFullName` | `string`         | Yes      | Repository in `owner/repo` format.                   |
| `targetDir`    | `string`         | Yes      | Local path where the repository will be cloned.      |
| `branch`       | `string`         | Yes      | Branch to check out after cloning.                   |
| `creds`        | `GitCredentials` | Yes      | Authentication credentials.                          |
| `opts`         | `CloneOptions`   | No       | Optional clone configuration (e.g. shallow depth).   |

**Returns:** `Promise<void>`

---

#### `GitHubProvider.createBranch`

Creates a new local branch in the given repository directory.

```ts
async createBranch(repoDir: string, branchName: string): Promise<void>
```

| Parameter    | Type     | Required | Description                          |
|--------------|----------|----------|--------------------------------------|
| `repoDir`    | `string` | Yes      | Path to the local repository.        |
| `branchName` | `string` | Yes      | Name of the branch to create.        |

**Returns:** `Promise<void>`

---

#### `GitHubProvider.commitAll`

Stages all changes and creates a commit with the provided message.

```ts
async commitAll(repoDir: string, message: string): Promise<void>
```

|-----------|----------|----------|--------------------------------------|

#### `GitHubProvider.createPR`

Creates a pull request on GitHub. If an open pull request for the same `head` → `base` already exists, it may be reused.

```ts
async createPR(
  repoFullName: string,
  head: string,
  base: string,
  title: string,
  body: string,
  creds: GitCredentials
): Promise<{ url: string; reused: boolean }>
```

| Parameter      | Type             | Required | Description                                      |
|----------------|------------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `repoFullName` | `string`         | Yes      | Repository in `owner/repo` format.               |
| `head`         | `string`         | Yes      | Source branch name.                              |
| `base`         | `string`         | Yes      | Target branch name.                              |
| `title`        | `string`         | Yes      | Title of the pull request.                       |
| `body`         | `string`         | Yes      | Body/description of the pull request.            |
| `creds`        | `GitCredentials` | Yes      | Authentication credentials.                      |

**Returns:** `Promise<{ url: string; reused: boolean }>` — The URL of the pull request and whether an existing PR was reused.

---

#### `GitHubProvider.commentOnPR`

Posts a comment on an existing GitHub pull request.

```ts
async commentOnPR(
  repoFullName: string,
  prUrl: string,
  comment: string,
  creds: GitCredentials
): Promise<void>
```

| Parameter      | Type             | Required | Description                            |
|----------------|------------------|----------|----------------------------------------|
| `repoFullName` | `string`         | Yes      | Repository in `owner/repo` format.     |
| `prUrl`        | `string`         | Yes      | URL of the target pull request.        |
| `comment`      | `string`         | Yes      | Comment text to post.                  |
| `creds`        | `GitCredentials` | Yes      | Authentication credentials.            |

**Returns:** `Promise<void>`

| `prUrl`        | `string`         | Yes      | URL of the pull request.               |
| `creds`        | `GitCredentials` | Yes      | Authentication credentials.            |

#### `GitHubProvider.fetchBranch`

Fetches a remote branch into the local repository. Returns `true` if the branch was found and fetched successfully, `false` otherwise.

```ts
async fetchBranch(
  repoDir: string,
  branch: string,
  creds: GitCredentials
): Promise<boolean>
```

| Parameter | Type             | Required | Description                          |
|-----------|------------------|----------|--------------------------------------|
| `repoDir` | `string`         | Yes      | Path to the local repository.        |
| `branch`  | `string`         | Yes      | Name of the remote branch to fetch.  |
| `creds`   | `GitCredentials` | Yes      | Authentication credentials.          |

**Returns:** `Promise<boolean>`

---

```ts
  repoFullName: string,
  prUrl: string,

```

| Parameter      | Type             | Required | Description                            |
|----------------|------------------|----------|----------------------------------------|
| `repoFullName` | `string`         | Yes      | Repository in `owner/repo` format.     |
| `prUrl`        | `string`         | Yes      | URL of the pull request.               |
| `creds`        | `GitCredentials` | Yes      | Authentication credentials.            |

**Returns:** `Promise<PRComment[]>` — Array of comments on the pull request.
